headlines.description: — Giannis Antetokounmpo had 31 points and 20 rebounds to help the Milwaukee Bucks beat the Toronto Raptors 122-116 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Antetokounmpo has 31 points and 20 rebounds in the Bucks' victory over the Raptors

headlines.description: — Trae Young scored six of his 25 points in the final 46 seconds, leading the Atlanta Hawks to a 111-107 win over the Orlando Magic on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trae Young scores 6 points in final 46 seconds to lead Hawks past Magic

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell scored 35 points, Jarrett Allen added 22, and Cleveland Cavaliers outlasted the Brooklyn Nets 131-124 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mitchell scores 35 as Cavaliers outlast Nets 131-124

events.name: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson scored 31 points, Karl-Anthony Towns had 26 points and 13 rebounds and the New York Knicks rode a huge second quarter to a 105-95 victory over the Boston Celtics on Friday night and a 2-0 start to the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brunson scores 31 points, Knicks ride huge 2nd quarter to 105-95 victory over the Celtics

headlines.description: — Cade Cunningham scored 21 points and made two free throws with 5.5 seconds left to help the Detroit Pistons hold on to beat the Houston Rockets 115-111 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cunningham's late free throws help Pistons beat Rockets 115-111

headlines.description: — Bam Adebayo scored 24 points and the Miami Heat won their first game since guard Terry Rozier was arrested...
headlines.shortLinkText: Bam Adebayo scores 24 points to help the Heat rout the Grizzlies, 146-114

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Victor Wembanyama had 29 points, 11 rebounds and nine blocks before fouling out in overtime, and the San Antonio Spurs held on to beat the New Orleans Pelicans 120-116 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wembanyama has 29 points, 11 rebounds and 9 blocks to lead Spurs past Pelicans, 120-116 in OT

headlines.description: — Kyshawn George scored a career-high 34 points, and the Washington Wizards turned away a Cooper Flagg-fueled rally for a 117-107 victory over Dallas on Friday night, dropping the Mavericks and their No. 1 overall pick to 0-2.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyshawn George scores 34 as Wizards turn away Cooper Flagg-fueled rally to beat Mavs

events.name: Minnesota Timberwolves at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic scored 49 points and became the fourth player in NBA history to begin a season with back-to-back 40-point performances, leading the Los Angeles Lakers to a 128-110 victory over the Minnesota Timberwolves on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luka Doncic scores 49 to extend his sizzling season start in Lakers' 128-110 win over Timberwolves

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Deni Avdija had 26 points and six assists, and the Portland Trail Blazers beat the Golden State Warriors 139-119 on Friday night in Tiago Splitter’s first game as interim head coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: Avdija scores 26 points as Trail Blazers beat Warriors 139-119 in Splitter's debut as interim coach

headlines.description: — Domantas Sabonis scored off an offensive rebound with six seconds remaining to cap a wild ending and lift the Sacramento Kings to a 105-104 win over the Utah Jazz on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sabonis helps Kings hold off Jazz for 105-104 victory

headlines.description: — James Harden scored 30 points, Kawhi Leonard added 27 and the Los Angeles Clippers routed the Phoenix Suns 129-102 Friday night in their home opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harden scores 30 points to help Clippers rout Suns 129-102 in home opener
